continuity_scope: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous Enhanced Edition, English-language official Owlcat campaign witness. The edition boundary is PC v2.0.0 / the console Enhanced Edition release: the free PC update and the console package described by Owlcat. The pass records only the selected main-campaign presentation; it does not import character/story claims from free DLC, paid DLC, later patches, other platforms, or tabletop continuities.
work_or_witnesses: Owlcat: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous official game page, The Game / Mythic Paths / Crusade Commander
Owlcat: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous Enhanced Edition on PC and Consoles Out Now
Owlcat: The New Adventure – Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous
coverage_rule: All stable named non-avatar dramatic agents directly named and functionally described in the selected official campaign overview: Areelu Vorlesh, Deskari, and Baphomet. The player-created Commander is excluded. No companion, NPC, crusade leader, deity, demon, or other individual is added without an equivalent individual claim-level Owlcat profile or direct in-game witness in the selected source set.
omissions: The player-created hero/Commander, all player name, ancestry, class, build, alignment, mythic path, crusade, romances, choices, recruits, allies, deaths, and endings.
All named companions, NPCs, antagonists, crusade leaders, deities, angels, demons, and other individuals not functionally profiled in the selected official overview.
Mythic paths, classes, ancestries, alignments, factions, deities, crusades, rules, armies, items, locations, rituals, and systems as character nodes.

All paid DLC and its characters/stories, including Through the Ashes, The Lord of Nothing, and A Dance of Masks; free DLC content; later patch-specific content; non-English localization; ports; the tabletop Wrath of the Righteous Adventure Path; Pathfinder 1e/2e books; other Pathfinder games; adaptations; fan/community/wiki materials; walkthroughs; and secondary character databases.
uncertainties: The game page is a high-level campaign witness, not an exhaustive cast directory or in-game dialogue/quest/codex archive. This is therefore a deliberately narrow three-character pass.

Owlcat states that the CRPG is based on the tabletop Adventure Path but includes new characters, plots, elements, and adapted mythic-path mechanics. Tabletop material is contextual only and does not establish CRPG-specific claims here.

Mythic paths and crusade choices are player-controlled and can permanently change the player character, companions, and world. No path, party, alliance, alignment shift, romance, death, or ending is made universal.

Enhanced Edition v2.0.0 adds patch- and platform-specific functionality, quest outcomes, and epilogues. The character claims remain limited to the campaign overview and are not claims about every historical/current build or DLC state.
Only English wording was reviewed. The official page describes antagonistic forces in campaign-premise language; no independent in-world adjudication or unlisted motive/power is inferred.
evidence_basis: First-party Owlcat campaign, edition, and development-announcement pages only. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, community guide, review, walkthrough, tabletop summary, or unofficial database is used as canonical evidence.
